1. # Since .env is gitignored, you can use .env.example to build a new `.env` file when you clone the repo.
2. # Keep this file up-to-date when you add new variables to `.env`.
3. 
4. # This file will be committed to version control, so make sure not to have any secrets in it.
5. # If you are cloning this repo, create a copy of this file named `.env` and populate it with your secrets.
6. 
7. # When adding additional env variables, the schema in ./env/index.js should be updated accordingly
8. 
9. # Next.js
10. NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000
11. # NEXT_PUBLIC_SHORT_BASE_URL=https://alveus.gg
12. NEXT_PUBLIC_NOINDEX=true
13. 
14. # Next.js: Tophat global promotion
15. # NEXT_PUBLIC_GLOBAL_PROMOTION_TITLE=T-shirts, hoodies, and more!
16. # NEXT_PUBLIC_GLOBAL_PROMOTION_CTA=Merch Available Now
17. # NEXT_PUBLIC_GLOBAL_PROMOTION_LINK=/apparel
18. # NEXT_PUBLIC_GLOBAL_PROMOTION_EXTERNAL=true
19. # NEXT_PUBLIC_GLOBAL_PROMOTION_EXCLUDED=
20. 
21. # Next.js: Donation page event banner
22. # NEXT_PUBLIC_DONATION_EVENT_TITLE=Alveus Charity Event
23. # NEXT_PUBLIC_DONATION_EVENT_DESCRIPTION=Looking to donate as part of the Alveus Charity Event, to get the limited edition postcard?
24. # NEXT_PUBLIC_DONATION_EVENT_CTA=Donate via Twitch Charity
25. # NEXT_PUBLIC_DONATION_EVENT_LINK=https://www.twitch.tv/charity/alveussanctuary
26. # NEXT_PUBLIC_DONATION_EVENT_EXTERNAL=true
27. 
28. # Prisma
29. DATABASE_URL='mysql://root:alveusgg_secret@localhost:3306/alveusgg'
30. SHADOW_DATABASE_URL='mysql://root:alveusgg_secret@localhost:3306/alveusgg_shadow'
31. 
32. # Next Auth
33. #   You can generate the secret via 'openssl rand -base64 32' on Linux
34. # More info: https://next-auth.js.org/configuration/options#secret
35. NEXTAUTH_SECRET=
36. NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000
37. 
38. # Twitch OAuth
39. TWITCH_CLIENT_ID=
40. TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET=
41. 
42. # Discord Bot
43. DISCORD_BOT_NAME="Alveus Test"
44. 
45. # Discord Channel Webhooks for notifications (optional, space-separated)
46. DISCORD_CHANNEL_WEBHOOK_URLS_STREAM_NOTIFICATION=https://discord.com/api/webhooks/aaa/xyz https://discord.com/api/webhooks/bbb/xyz
47. DISCORD_CHANNEL_WEBHOOK_URLS_ANNOUNCEMENT=https://discord.com/api/webhooks/ccc/xyz
48. 
49. # Send discord Channel notifications to @everyone (optional, defaults to false)
50. #DISCORD_CHANNEL_WEBHOOK_TO_EVERYONE_STREAM_NOTIFICATION=true
51. #DISCORD_CHANNEL_WEBHOOK_TO_EVERYONE_ANNOUNCEMENT=true
52. 
53. # Action API secret
54. #   You can generate the secret via 'openssl rand -base64 32' on Linux
55. ACTION_API_SECRET=
56. 
57. # Vercel Cron secret (see https://vercel.com/docs/cron-jobs/manage-cron-jobs#securing-cron-jobs)
58. #   You can generate the secret via 'openssl rand -base64 32' on Linux
59. CRON_SECRET=
60. 
61. # Weather API secret
62. #   You can add a weather station to wunderground.com for this
63. # More info: https://www.wunderground.com/member/api-keys
64. #            https://www.wunderground.com/pws/overview
65. WEATHER_API_KEY=
66. WEATHER_STATION_ID=INUNAV15
67. 
68. # Web Push VAPID Key
69. #   You can generate the keys via 'npx web-push generate-vapid-keys'
70. NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=
71. WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=
72. WEB_PUSH_VAPID_SUBJECT=mailto:admin@alveus.gg
73. 
74. # File Storage (S3-compatible)
75. FILE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000
76. FILE_STORAGE_SECRET=alveusgg_secret
77. FILE_STORAGE_REGION=us-east-1
78. FILE_STORAGE_KEY=alveusgg_key
79. FILE_STORAGE_CDN_URL=
80. FILE_STORAGE_BUCKET=alveusgg
81. FILE_STORAGE_PATH_STYLE=true # MinIO requires path style
82. 
83. # Upstash QStash (optional)
84. UPSTASH_QSTASH_URL=https://qstash.upstash.io/v1/publish/
85. UPSTASH_QSTASH_KEY=
86. 
87. # Super users
88. SUPER_USER_IDS=
89. 
90. # Encryption passphrase for data at rest
91. #   You can generate the secret via 'openssl rand -base64 24' on Linux
92. DATA_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE=
93.
